thesis: The most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is social proof through product reviews, but it is bleeding value because product pages show a 'Reviews' heading with no actual review content, ratings, or social proof, undermining purchase confidence and directly suppressing add-to-cart conversions.

findings.title: Heavy third-party script load
findings.summary: The homepage loads 63 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.problem: The homepage loads 63 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Audit third-party tags, defer non-critical scripts, and remove duplicated analytics or marketing pixels.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 inline and 22 external <script> tags, 698 KB of HTML.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Product pages lack visible reviews
findings.summary: Product pages show a reviews heading but no actual review content, ratings, or social proof, undermining purchase confidence.
findings.problem: Product pages show a reviews heading but no actual review content, ratings, or social proof, undermining purchase confidence.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Add to Cart; notes: Ensure review summaries, star ratings, and at least a few review excerpts render visibly on product pages near the add-to-cart area.
findings.evidence: h2: Reviews for Anytime Ankle Sock | h2: Added to Cart
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No guarantee or return policy
findings.summary: Product pages lack shipping, return, or guarantee messaging near the purchase path, reducing trust at the decision point.
findings.problem: Product pages lack shipping, return, or guarantee messaging near the purchase path, reducing trust at the decision point.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Add to Cart; notes: Display a concise return policy and satisfaction guarantee message directly on product pages near the price and add-to-cart controls.
findings.evidence: copy: Free ground shipping on orders over $100 | h2: Refund policy
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Shipping threshold not prominent
findings.summary: The free shipping threshold is buried in page copy rather than surfaced near prices or CTAs, so visitors may not see it until checkout.
findings.problem: The free shipping threshold is buried in page copy rather than surfaced near prices or CTAs, so visitors may not see it until checkout.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Display the free shipping threshold prominently near product prices and in the cart drawer so it is visible before checkout.
findings.evidence: Free ground shipping on orders over $100
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Late fee disclosure on product pages
findings.summary: Product pages show prices but no shipping or fee information near the price, leaving cost details to be discovered later in the funnel.
findings.problem: Product pages show prices but no shipping or fee information near the price, leaving cost details to be discovered later in the funnel.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add a shipping and returns cost summary directly on product pages near the price to set expectations before add-to-cart.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Email form lacks visible labels
findings.summary: Email input fields lack visible labels, causing user confusion about what information is required.
findings.problem: Email input fields lack visible labels, causing user confusion about what information is required.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Sign Up / Get Notified; notes: Add visible, descriptive labels to each email input so users clearly understand what to enter before submitting.
findings.evidence: form: inputs=1 submit=Sign Up labels=[] | form: inputs=1 submit=Get Notified labels=['Email']
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Trust signals absent from collection
findings.summary: Collection page lacks any review, rating, or credibility indicators, offering no social proof while users browse products.
findings.problem: Collection page lacks any review, rating, or credibility indicators, offering no social proof while users browse products.
findings.recommended_change: h1: SHOP ALL '26; notes: Add star ratings or review counts to product cards on collection pages to build trust during browsing.
findings.evidence: copy: SHOP ALL '26 Free ground shipping on orders over $100 | h2: Refund policy
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Price context missing on collection
findings.summary: Collection page lists prices without indicating which items are on sale or the regular price, reducing transparency on value.
findings.problem: Collection page lists prices without indicating which items are on sale or the regular price, reducing transparency on value.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Show strikethrough original prices and sale badges on collection tiles so shoppers can see the discount at a glance.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Controls without accessible names
findings.summary: 41 of 79 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
findings.problem: 41 of 79 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Give every control a visible text label or an aria-label. WCAG 2.2 AA, success criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 of 79 <button> elements contain no text content and no aria-label.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Images missing alternative text
findings.summary: 3 of 43 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.problem: 3 of 43 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add descriptive alt text; use alt="" only for decorative images.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 3 of 43 elements have no alt attribute.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
